name: Lodestar Fist
description: Throw a punch along the line to the lodestar so it lands true on the point aimed at.

name: Lodestar Guard
description: Fix the guard on the lodestar and let a blow break against a stance that does not move.

name: Lodestar Step
description: Walk the line to the lodestar in steps that never turn aside from it.

name: Lodestar Sight
description: Fix the foe in the lodestar's light and keep him in view whichever way he moves.

name: Lodestar Pierce
description: Send a thin line of starlight from the lodestar through the guard and into the body.

name: Lodestar Mend
description: Draw a wound back into line by the lodestar's steady light in yourself or an ally.

name: Lodestar Volley
description: Loose bolts that all fly true to the lodestar's mark and strike the same spot.

name: Lodestar Cover
description: Spread the lodestar's light over yourself and your allies as a firm cover against heavy blows.

name: Lodestar Command
description: Raise the lodestar high and fix every ally's strength upon it for the whole of a fight.

name: Lodestar Descent
description: The school's closing move that brings the lodestar down along a sighted line through the foe with a force that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Aphelion Fist
description: Punch with a cold slow weight that lands like a stone dropped from a great height.

name: Aphelion Guard
description: Hold a cold heavy shell of starlight round the body that slows any blow that enters it.

name: Aphelion Step
description: Take a long slow stride that seems to cost nothing and covers the ground at its own pace.

name: Aphelion Drag
description: Let the cold slow light settle on the foe so his limbs drag and his techniques come late.

name: Aphelion Pierce
description: Drive a long cold needle of starlight through the guard and leave it chilling the core.

name: Aphelion Mend
description: Let the cold slow light settle on a wound and numb and close it in yourself or an ally.

name: Aphelion Cleanse
description: Chill a spreading taint until it stops and then draw it out of yourself or an ally.

name: Aphelion Volley
description: Loose cold bolts that slow in flight and then strike with the weight of a falling star.

name: Aphelion Cover
description: Spread a cold cover of slow light over yourself and your allies that drags every blow to a halt.

name: Aphelion Stillness
description: Spread the stillness of the farthest orbit over the field so all foes in it move as if through deep cold.

name: Far Aphelion
description: The school's closing move that sends the field to its farthest and coldest point where every foe is held for a span that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Crownstar Fist
description: Throw a fist ringed by a small crown of starlight that lights the foe at the moment of impact.

name: Crownstar Guard
description: Set a crown of bright points about the head and shoulders that turns a blow from above.

name: Crownstar Step
description: Stride forward under a bright crown that lights the way and marks the place of landing.

name: Crownstar Sight
description: Let the crown spread its light wide and show every foe and ally in the field.

name: Crownstar Pierce
description: Draw one star out of the crown and drive it as a spear through the foe's guard.

name: Crownstar Mend
description: Rest the crown's gentle light on a deep hurt and close it in yourself or an ally.

name: Crownstar Rain
description: Let every star of the crown fall at once in a rain that strikes the whole field.

name: Crownstar Mantle
description: Spread the crown into a full mantle round yourself and your allies that dims the heaviest blows.

name: Crownstar Blaze
description: Blaze the whole crown at once so every foe in the field is scorched by starlight.

name: Crowning Star
description: The school's closing move that sets one great star on the crown and loosed it as a blaze that strikes foes and strengthens allies with a force that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Mariner Fist
description: Throw a punch along a line held steady by the guiding star above.

name: Mariner Guard
description: Hold the guard steady as a ship steers and let a blow slide along the line of the stance.

name: Mariner Step
description: Roll the stride like a deck underfoot and keep the star-fixed course without a wobble.

name: Mariner Sight
description: Fix the position of every ally and foe by the stars and keep it as they move.

name: Mariner Pierce
description: Send a bright line of qi along the course to the mark and through the guard.

name: Mariner Mend
description: Steer a stream of starlight along an injury until it closes in yourself or an ally.

name: Mariner Cleanse
description: Steer a taint out of the blood along a chosen course by starlight in yourself or an ally.

name: Mariner Volley
description: Loose bolts of starlight along one steady course so they strike in a single line.

name: Mariner Cover
description: Spread a steady cover of starlight over yourself and your allies that rides out heavy blows.

name: Mariner Leap
description: Steer by the fixed star and cross the whole field in one bright leap.

name: Guide Star
description: The school's closing move that lights a guide star over allies and fixes their strength and sight upon it with a force that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Chartstar Fist
description: Punch along a line drawn on the star chart between fist and target.

name: Chartstar Guard
description: Hold the guard on the chart point where the blow must fall and take it there.

name: Chartstar Step
description: Step from star to star of the chart and land on the point that was marked.

name: Chartstar Turn
description: Read the line of a blow on the chart and turn it off at the right angle.

name: Chartstar Sight
description: Lay the chart over the field and read the place and the weak point of every foe on it.

name: Chartstar Pierce
description: Draw a chart line through the foe and drive qi down it from end to end.

name: Chartstar Mend
description: Trace the chart line along an injury and close it point by point in yourself or an ally.

name: Chartstar Cleanse
description: Trace the chart through a tainted body and draw the taint out along its lines.

name: Chartstar Barrage
description: Throw bolts from every star of the chart at once so all arrive on the foe together.

name: Chartstar Cover
description: Spread the chart over yourself and your allies as a cover that shares each blow among its stars.

name: Chartstar Reckoning
description: Close every line of the chart on the one point of the foe that must fail.

name: Charted Doom
description: The school's closing move that draws every line of the chart to a close on the field with a doom that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Starsworn Fist
description: Punch with a fist sworn to the stars and carrying a bright point of their light.

name: Starsworn Guard
description: Hold the guard under a star-sworn light that blunts any blow that comes into it.

name: Starsworn Step
description: Step under the stars' sworn light so every stride is sure and quiet.

name: Starsworn Sight
description: Ask the sworn stars to show the field and see each foe by their light.

name: Starsworn Pierce
description: Call a sworn star down as a spear through the guard and into the foe.

name: Starsworn Mend
description: Ask the sworn stars to close a wound and let their light knit it for yourself or an ally.

name: Starsworn Volley
description: Loose a sworn volley of bolts that never miss the mark the oath was given upon.

name: Starsworn Cover
description: Spread the stars' sworn light over yourself and your allies as a firm cover.

name: Starsworn Oath
description: Swear the oath of the stars over your allies so they are made strong and kept from harm.

name: Sworn Constellation
description: The school's closing move that raises a sworn constellation to strike the foes and strengthen the allies with a force that scales with the user's reserve.
